      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical call-site updates that follow from changes elsewhere do not make a PR a member of the indexes category."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Lacks Kernel label; changes in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp are purely mechanical call-site updates.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter the kernel library boundary, API design, or node-decoupling effort."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Lacks mempool/policy labels; edits in src/policy/ and src/txmempool.cpp are mechanical call-site updates.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not change mempool data structures, eviction, fee estimation, or policy rules."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/node/miner.cpp and src/rpc/mining.cpp are mechanical call-site updates.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not touch block assembly or mining interfaces beyond mechanical caller updates."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches p2p download files purely to adapt call sites to the new CTransaction observers.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter peer-to-peer protocols, transport, or network message processing."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits across RPC files are mechanical replacements of CTransaction member accesses with observers.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not change RPC commands, schemas, or server behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches fuzz and unit tests only to update call sites to the new CTransaction observer methods.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical updates to existing tests following a refactor do not constitute test framework work."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Lacks Scripts and tools label; the bitcoin-tidy check under contrib/devtools/bitcoin-tidy is purpose-built to automate this refactoring.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The included clang-tidy check is secondary scaffolding to automate the CTransaction migration rather than a user-facing tool."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches common utility files only to update CTransaction call sites.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter shared utility libraries, logging, or cryptographic primitives."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Validation label and alters core consensus data structure interfaces in src/primitives/transaction.h and call sites in src/validation.cpp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.3,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Encapsulates CTransaction data members behind const observer methods to decouple internal storage representation from public APIs. The author explains that this enables potential future directions such as using shared immutable transaction state or block offsets, but notes it 'is not a prerequisite for the stateless validation library' in #35904. Because it is an internal architectural restructuring without an immediate bug fix, performance impact, or hard dependency, it represents worthwhile but deferrable cleanup."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes across src/wallet/ are mechanical call-site migrations to the new CTransaction observer methods.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter wallet functionality, coin selection, descriptors, or storage."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 0,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
